proposal.reason: Main change is a new CE/DMA-backed host one-sided RMA path (Put/Signal/WaitSignal) with new CE context/state, signal/ack memory, batching, and launch/finalization logic. enqueue is additionally required because the PR introduces a new RMA task type, per-context planner queues, plan construction/batching, and launch routing for RMA plans. other is needed because a new public host RMA API/config surface (pcclPutSignal/pcclSignal/pcclWaitSignal, wait descriptors, numRmaCtx exposure/gating) is added outside a dedicated catalog module.
